farm.disclaimer: This tool supports your own knowledge and your Agricultural Instructor. It does not replace them.
farm.err.title: Something went wrong
farm.err.offline_title: The farm service is not reachable
farm.err.offline: We could not reach the farm service. Check your internet, or ask whoever runs it to start it.
farm.err.start_hint: On the computer that runs it, open the project folder and start it with this command:
farm.err.address: This page is looking for the service at: {url}
farm.err.kept_on_phone: Anything you typed is kept on this phone until it can be sent.
farm.err.login_again: Your sign-in has ended. Please sign in again.
farm.err.no_farm: We could not find that farm.
farm.soon.title: Coming soon
farm.soon.text: This part of the farm planner is not ready yet.
farm.auth.title: Sign in
farm.auth.lead: Use your phone number. We send you a short code. No password.
farm.auth.phone_bad: Please type your full phone number.
farm.auth.send_failed: The code could not be sent.
farm.auth.too_many: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes.
farm.auth.privacy: Your phone number is only used to keep your farms private to you.
farm.auth.code_sent: A code was requested for {phone}. Type it below.
farm.auth.dev_code: the code is {code}. A real farmer never sees this box; the code would come by SMS.
farm.auth.code_wrong: That code is not right, or it has run out. Ask for a new one.
farm.home.title: My farms
farm.home.lead: Pick a farm to see what the satellites say about it, or add a new one.
farm.home.none: You have no farms yet. Add your first farm.
farm.reg.title: Add your farm
farm.reg.lead: Six short steps. You can change everything later.
farm.reg.draft_restored: We kept what you typed last time on this phone.
farm.reg.name: What do you call this field?
farm.reg.where_help: Tap the map on your field, or press the button if you are standing in it.
farm.reg.map_label: Map. Tap to place your field.
farm.reg.no_map: The map could not load. Type the latitude and longitude below, or use your location.
farm.reg.outside_sl: That point is not in Sri Lanka. Please check it.
farm.reg.outside_pilot: Careful: the prepared satellite data covers only the Anuradhapura district for now. You can still save, but some cards may say there is not enough data.
farm.reg.loc_unavailable: Your location could not be found. Tap the map instead.
farm.reg.outline_title: Draw the edge of the field (optional)
farm.reg.outline_help: Press Start, then tap the corners of your field on the map, then Finish. If you skip this we use a circle with the same area.
farm.reg.outline_drawing: {n} corners so far. Tap more corners, then Finish.
farm.reg.outline_few: An outline needs at least three corners.
farm.reg.area: Size of the field in hectares
farm.reg.area_help: 1 hectare is about 2.5 acres. If you drew the outline we fill this in for you.
farm.reg.water_source: Where does your water come from?
farm.reg.yala_water: Is there water for the Yala season?
farm.reg.labour: How much labour do you have?
farm.reg.equipment: How much equipment do you have?
farm.reg.prio_help: Slide each one. The percentages always add up to 100.
farm.reg.hist_help: Choose the main crop of each past season. Skip any you do not remember.
farm.reg.hist_unavailable: The crop list could not be loaded now. You can add this later.
farm.reg.save_failed: The farm could not be saved.
farm.reg.saved_on_phone: No connection. Your answers are kept on this phone. Try again when you are online.
farm.reg.err_place: Please choose where the field is.
farm.reg.err_area: Please type the size of the field (more than 0 hectares).
farm.reg.err_water_source: Please say where your water comes from.
farm.reg.err_yala_water: Please say if there is water for Yala.
farm.reg.err_labour: Please say how much labour you have.
farm.reg.err_equipment: Please say how much equipment you have.
farm.reg.err_prio: Please give at least one thing some importance.
farm.loc.title: {name}: location and climate
farm.loc.lead: What the satellites say about your area. Each box says where its numbers come from.
farm.loc.failed: The location card could not be loaded.
farm.loc.no_location: The location details are not available yet.
farm.loc.no_profile: The climate profile is not available yet.
farm.loc.plot_circle: A circle of the same area (not your real shape)
farm.sec.climate_monthly: Rain and water balance by month
farm.sec.bare: Months the land is usually bare
farm.loc.area_level: Area-level ({res}): the same number for the whole area, not just your field
farm.loc.cloud_note: Clouds hide the land from satellites in the rainy months, so some greenness values have gaps. Gaps are left empty, not guessed.
farm.gt.title: Help us check the satellite
farm.gt.lead: Two taps. Your answer helps us see if the satellite matches your field. It is not shared with anyone else.
farm.gt.failed: Your answer could not be sent.
farm.gt.q.rain_onset: The satellite rain record says the {season} rains usually start around {date}. Does that match what you remember?
farm.loc.rain_vs_et0: Bars for each month: rain and the water the sun and wind take back
farm.loc.key_et0: Water lost to sun and wind (ET0, estimated)
farm.loc.outside_pilot: The prepared data does not cover this place yet.
farm.loc.wettest: Wettest month: {month}, about {mm} mm of rain on average.
farm.loc.short_months: In these months the sun and wind take back more water than the rain brings: {months}.
farm.loc.no_short_months: In no month do the sun and wind take back more water than the rain brings.
farm.loc.onset_text: The rains usually start around {median}. Earliest {earliest}, latest {latest}.
farm.loc.onset_years: Counted over {n} years with a start; {none} years had none.
farm.loc.onset_chart_help: Each bar is one year: days after {start} until the rains started. A taller bar is a later start. Empty = no start found. The rule for "rains started" is a draft.
farm.loc.dry_text: In a usual season the longest dry spell is about {median} days. The worst was {worst} days in {year}.
farm.loc.ndvi_text: Greenness seen from space over the last year (one picture about every 16 days). Brown = bare land, green = plants growing.
farm.loc.ndvi_tanks: Measured around {n} real tanks in this area, not on your field. Hatched = a cloud hid the land.
farm.loc.bare_often: The land here is usually bare in: {months}.
farm.loc.bare_never: In the years we looked at ({years}), the land was not bare in most years in any month.
farm.loc.bare_help: Each square is a month. Brown = bare in more years, green = rarely bare. The bare limit is a draft.
farm.loc.gaps_title: What we do not have yet
farm.gt.q.ndvi_latest: On {date} the satellite measured greenness {value} (0 is bare, 1 is very green) around tanks near you. Does that fit the land near you?
